description: National Census of Ferry Operators (NCFO) 2018: Operator Terminal data is a dataset listed in data.bts.gov (Bureau of Transportation Statistics open data), an open data portal of the Bureau of Transportation Statistics under the section "Transit", published or maintained by U.S. Bureau of Transportation Statistics. Reported 2017 calendar year ferry terminals as surveyed by the 2018 NCFO. Some terminals are reported by more than one ferry operator. Coverage: United States (see the dataset for state or local subsets). The portal files it under "Transit". It has 19 columns, among them LONGITUDE, CENSUS_YEAR, TERM_COUNTRY, TERM_STATE, TERM_CITY, TERMINAL_NAME. The portal shows 2020-05-05 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC0-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, safety and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-bts-data-bts-gov-portal.
